title: Psalm 60
opening_line: O Lord, thou hast rejected us,

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: O Lord, thou hast rejected us,
text.normalized: O Lord, thou hast rejected us,
text.reading: O Lord, thou hast rejected us,

text.diplomatic: and scatter’d us abroad;
text.normalized: And scatter’d us abroad;
text.reading: and scatter’d us abroad;

text.diplomatic: Thou justly hast displeasèd been;
text.normalized: Thou justly hast displeasèd been;
text.reading: Thou justly hast displeasèd been;

text.diplomatic: return to us, O God.
text.normalized: Return to us, O God.
text.reading: return to us, O God.

text.diplomatic: The earth to tremble thou hast made;
text.normalized: The earth to tremble thou hast made;
text.reading: The earth to tremble thou hast made;

text.diplomatic: therein didst breaches make:
text.normalized: Therein didst breaches make:
text.reading: therein didst breaches make:

text.diplomatic: Do thou thereof the breaches heal,
text.normalized: Do thou thereof the breaches heal,
text.reading: Do thou thereof the breaches heal,

text.diplomatic: because the land doth shake.
text.normalized: Because the land doth shake.
text.reading: because the land doth shake.

text.diplomatic: Unto thy people thou hard things
text.normalized: Unto thy people thou hard things
text.reading: Unto thy people thou hard things

text.diplomatic: hast showed, and on them sent;
text.normalized: Hast showed, and on them sent;
text.reading: hast showed, and on them sent;

text.diplomatic: And thou hast causèd us to drink
text.normalized: And thou hast causèd us to drink
text.reading: And thou hast causèd us to drink

text.diplomatic: wine of astonishment.
text.normalized: Wine of astonishment.
text.reading: wine of astonishment.

text.diplomatic: And yet a banner thou hast given
text.normalized: And yet a banner thou hast given
text.reading: And yet a banner thou hast given

text.diplomatic: to them who thee do fear;
text.normalized: To them who thee do fear;
text.reading: to them who thee do fear;

text.diplomatic: That it by them, because of truth,
text.normalized: That it by them, because of truth,
text.reading: That it by them, because of truth,

text.diplomatic: displayèd may appear.
text.normalized: Displayèd may appear.
text.reading: displayèd may appear.

text.diplomatic: That thy belovèd people may
text.normalized: That thy belovèd people may
text.reading: That thy belovèd people may

text.diplomatic: delivered be from thrall,
text.normalized: Delivered be from thrall,
text.reading: delivered be from thrall,

text.diplomatic: Save with the pow’r of thy right hand,
text.normalized: Save with the pow’r of thy right hand,
text.reading: Save with the pow’r of thy right hand,

text.diplomatic: and hear me when I call.
text.normalized: And hear me when I call.
text.reading: and hear me when I call.

text.diplomatic: God in his holiness hath spoke;
text.normalized: God in his holiness hath spoke;
text.reading: God in his holiness hath spoke;

text.diplomatic: herein I will take pleasure:
text.normalized: Herein I will take pleasure:
text.reading: herein I will take pleasure:

text.diplomatic: Shechem I will divide, and forth
text.normalized: Shechem I will divide, and forth
text.reading: Shechem I will divide, and forth

text.diplomatic: will Succoth’s valley measure.
text.normalized: Will Succoth’s valley measure.
text.reading: will Succoth’s valley measure.

text.diplomatic: Gilead I claim as mine by right;
text.normalized: Gilead I claim as mine by right;
text.reading: Gilead I claim as mine by right;

text.diplomatic: Manasseh mine shall be;
text.normalized: Manasseh mine shall be;
text.reading: Manasseh mine shall be;

text.diplomatic: Ephraim is of mine head the strength;
text.normalized: Ephraim is of mine head the strength;
text.reading: Ephraim is of mine head the strength;

text.diplomatic: Judah gives laws for me;
text.normalized: Judah gives laws for me;
text.reading: Judah gives laws for me;

text.diplomatic: Moab’s my washing-pot; my shoe
text.normalized: Moab’s my washing-pot; my shoe
text.reading: Moab’s my washing-pot; my shoe

text.diplomatic: I’ll over Edom throw;
text.normalized: I’ll over Edom throw;
text.reading: I’ll over Edom throw;

text.diplomatic: And over Palestina’s land
text.normalized: And over Palestina’s land
text.reading: And over Palestina’s land

text.diplomatic: I will in triumph go.
text.normalized: I will in triumph go.
text.reading: I will in triumph go.

text.diplomatic: O who is he will bring me to
text.normalized: O who is he will bring me to
text.reading: O who is he will bring me to

text.diplomatic: the city fortified?
text.normalized: The city fortified?
text.reading: the city fortified?

text.diplomatic: O who is he that to the land
text.normalized: O who is he that to the land
text.reading: O who is he that to the land

text.diplomatic: of Edom will me guide?
text.normalized: Of Edom will me guide?
text.reading: of Edom will me guide?

text.diplomatic: O God, which hadest us cast off,
text.normalized: O God, which hadest us cast off,
text.reading: O God, which hadest us cast off,

text.diplomatic: this thing wilt thou not do?
text.normalized: This thing wilt thou not do?
text.reading: this thing wilt thou not do?

text.diplomatic: Ev’n thou, O God, which didest not
text.normalized: Ev’n thou, O God, which didest not
text.reading: Ev’n thou, O God, which didest not

text.diplomatic: forth with our armies go?
text.normalized: Forth with our armies go?
text.reading: forth with our armies go?

text.diplomatic: Help us from trouble; for the help
text.normalized: Help us from trouble; for the help
text.reading: Help us from trouble; for the help

text.diplomatic: is vain which man supplies.
text.normalized: Is vain which man supplies.
text.reading: is vain which man supplies.

text.diplomatic: Through God we’ll do great acts; he shall
text.normalized: Through God we’ll do great acts; he shall
text.reading: Through God we’ll do great acts; he shall

text.diplomatic: tread down our enemies.
text.normalized: Tread down our enemies.
text.reading: tread down our enemies.
